(2) The person in the mask attempts to snatch a red purse from the man in the dress. An older man in a black t-shirt enters the frame holding a black frying pan (wok) and begins tossing it as if cooking, while the struggle continues in the middle ground. (3) A man in a suit and glasses appears in a separate cut, looking seriously at the camera while adjusting his glasses. He then appears in the scene with the others, holding a document and pointing to it while the robbery struggle continues. The camera maintains a medium shot at eye-level, capturing the chaotic interaction on the paved walkway. (5) A young man in a beige t-shirt enters the frame holding a silver baseball bat. He begins swinging the bat rhythmically at the air, ignoring the actual robbery, with a joyful expression on his face. (6) A young woman wearing a beige cardigan and denim shorts enters holding a selfie stick with a microphone attached. She speaks directly to her phone as if livestreaming, using the ongoing robbery as her background content.
